scene: A tiny spiral galaxy swirls softly inside the humming dryer door.
picture: A flat side view of the laundromat. Far left sits an abandoned glowing blue sock on checkered tiles. The player stands left in a yellow raincoat, round afro, and green boots, holding a red umbrella, leaning toward a purple-glowing dryer at centre with a round closed door. Up high rests a bright red dial. Far right shows an open vending cart.
shown: a round chrome dryer door at the centre, glowing purple and shut
a red plastic dial positioned up high above the dryer drum
